origin: Generated for this project with imagegen from the project-owned body-overview design, 2026-10-17
runtime: Native Canvas fixed silhouette clips and visible-bellies-v2 independently traced side geometry; the same paths drive tint, selection, picking and thumbnails.
limitations: Illustrative, not clinical anatomy or measured physiological load. Clothing-covered muscles remain accessible via text list; no false coloring of clothing.

geometry.exclusions: Midline, abdominal inscriptions and navel, kneecaps, Achilles/wrist/elbow tendons, clothing and nonrepresented muscle groups. Glutes stay covered; front calf masks include only the visible medial belly, not anterior shin.
